go_hold.subject: Loaf Ledger paid product
go_hold.rationale: Clear, repeated pain (pricing from ingredients only, fear of losing customers, not knowing the hourly wage) and paid templates at $8-$29. The audience is low-revenue (median $2,000 sales in 2016), so price must stay low and the product must pay for itself on one market day.
go_hold.falsifying_test: If the workbook is live and gets 300+ sessions in 60 days with zero sales, hold Loaf Ledger and fold its traffic into an email list. Owner-adjustable rule.

positioning.one_line: Home and cottage bakers chronically undercharge and know it; paid pricing spreadsheets sell at $8-$29 but almost all are cake-focused, so a bread and farmers-market pricing and profit workbook at about $15-$19 is an open, cheap-to-build position for Loaf Ledger.
